sourceText.he: הָאִשָּׁה שֶׁנֶּהֶרְגָה וְכוּ׳. וְאַמַּאי? אִיסּוּרֵי הֲנָאָה נִינְהוּ! אָמַר רַב: בְּאוֹמֶרֶת ״תְּנוּ שְׂעָרִי לְבִתִּי״. אִילּוּ אָמְרָה ״תְּנוּ יָדִי לְבִתִּי״, מִי יָהֲבִינַן לַהּ?!

positions.claim: benefit may be derived from the hair of an executed woman
the mishna speaks of a woman who instructed that her hair be given to her daughter
her instruction cannot be what permits it, since she could not likewise donate her hand
